title: UI Layout Dirty Breadth Data Table v1
problem: Data-table retained and view-cache proof surfaces are now correct but still layout-dominant on filter, sort, pinning, and reset interactions. This lane attributes and reduces layout invalidation breadth while preserving fret-ui mechanism boundaries and ecosystem policy ownership.

repro.summary: Use data-table retained and view-cache interaction scripts, then run diag stats on the worst retained/view-cache bundles.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag suite ui-gallery-data-table-retained --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_DATA_TABLE_RETAINED=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_DIAG_MAX_SNAPSHOTS=240 --launch -- target/release/fret-ui-gallery

cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag suite ui-gallery-data-table-view-cache-torture --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_DIAG_MAX_SNAPSHOTS=240 --launch -- target/release/fret-ui-gallery
cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag stats <bundle.schema2.json> --sort invalidation --top 30

gates.name: retained-data-table-correctness
gates.command: cargo test -p fret-ui-kit --lib table_virtualized_retained_header_debug_ids_click_sort_actions -- --nocapture && cargo test -p fret-ui-shadcn --lib retained_data_table_header_debug_ids_sort_with_column_actions -- --nocapture

gates.name: data-table-retained-diag-suite
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag suite ui-gallery-data-table-retained --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_DATA_TABLE_RETAINED=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_DIAG_MAX_SNAPSHOTS=240 --launch -- target/release/fret-ui-gallery

gates.name: data-table-view-cache-diag-suite
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag suite ui-gallery-data-table-view-cache-torture --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_DIAG_MAX_SNAPSHOTS=240 --launch -- target/release/fret-ui-gallery

continue_policy.notes: Closed after three bounded slices: high-frequency input chrome motion opt-out, page cache containment for data-table proof surfaces, and a mount-time redundant structural walk fastpath. Future row/cell structural churn work should use a narrower fret-ui-kit table subtree follow-on.
